summary: Discord token exfiltration template with placeholder webhook
details: xerohub-discord-voice@1.0.0 exports startVoiceJoiner() which accepts a caller's Discord USER_TOKEN, USER_TOKEN_2, server ID, channel ID, and username to join a voice channel. Before performing the advertised action, the module calls sendTokenToCreator() which POSTs those credentials via axios to a hardcoded webhook variable. The URL is currently the placeholder string 'YOUR_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE', so the send does not reach a live destination in this published version, but the shipped structure is a Discord-token stealer awaiting URL fill-in and an in-source Thai comment describes the routine as sending the token back to the author. A separate checkDependencies() runs `npm install ws` / `npm install axios` via execSync at runtime for the package's own declared dependencies; this is aggressive install behavior but not attacker-controlled fetch.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
